id: # The 20 terrains of terrain-and-map.md and fixtures/map/terrain-types.tsv. The id is the terrain id of the map (formats/map-data.md), so a hex of hexes.tsv has its terrain id as its kind.

# cost_*: the movement points to enter: the 劍 row (foot), the 軍馬 row (cavalry), the 衝車 row (siege) and the 走舸 row (navy) of movement-costs.tsv; 0 = cannot enter (255 in the spec). movement_costs.tsv has the row of each armament (code).
# needs_technique: the technique key that a unit needs to enter (small path, shallows: 難所行軍), or - (documented).

# loss_percent: soldiers lost when the unit enters (plank road, poison spring; documented that soldiers are lost, the percent is assumed). loss_waiver_technique and loss_waiver_skill stop the loss (難所行軍, 踏破 #7, 解毒 #9; a skill is its number in skills.md).

# buildable: a military facility, an obstacle or a fire trap can stand on it (military_build, code). enterable: a unit can stand on it (code). burnable: a fire stays on it without a unit (code; the manual says that sand does not burn, Q-198).
# tactics: the classes whose tactics work on it (documented). tile: the colour of the atlas. level: the height of the placeholder map; the real map gives a height to each hex.
